conviction_note: Zero. I found nothing the price is missing. The things that could move FUL on this print are the Q4 guide under a September oil spike, the AMS leverage and the activists, and all of them are in the wire and already behind a -13.7% 20-day run-up to 1.5% above the 52-week low. The only non-wire lead I had was a proxy read from Avery Dennison's Q2 pre-buy unwind, and FUL's own Q2 volumes contradict it, so I dropped it.
bar: Q3 FY26 company guide: net revenue up mid-single digits on Q3 FY25's $892M (about $928-955M) and adjusted EBITDA $180-190M, excluding AMS (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/39368/000143774926021622/ex_980922.htm; Q3 FY25 base https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250924779047/en/H.B.-Fuller-Reports-Third-Quarter-2025-Results). Street: $1.46 EPS / $945.5M revenue (Alphastreet, 7 analysts, https://news.alphastreet.com/h-b-fuller-q3-2026-earnings-preview-september-24-street-expects-1-46-eps/) and $1.47 / $948.3M (Investing.com, https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/h-b-fuller-set-to-report-earnings-as-activist-pressure-mounts-93CH-4913246). The two estimate sources agree and sit inside the upper half of the company guide. The FY26 guide is $4.60-4.90 EPS against $1.97 year to date, which implies $2.63-2.93 for H2.
positioning_check: Short interest is 1.94% of float with 2.5 days to cover, about 1.05M shares (MarketBeat, read 2026-09-23 via the sweep, settlement date not shown: https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/FUL/short-interest/). outside_window.finding: AMS scheme court sanction and completion are expected by calendar year-end 2026. Pro forma leverage is about 4x at close, and the $3.0B bridge still has to be refinanced in the bond market. Neither has a date inside the 2026-09-24 window.

searched_and_found_nothing: Why the stock fell 20d: no company filing explains it. EDGAR since June shows the 06-25 2.02, 06-26 and 07-20 8-Ks (bridge and credit agreements), a 13G and Form 4s. The 2026-09-14 Form 4s (CFO Corkrean, SVP Campe) are phantom-unit/RSU accruals, not open-market trades. https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0000039368&type=4&dateb=&owner=include&count=20

Macro in the window: Brent fell to about $70-90 in June-August (FUL's Q3), then re-spiked above $100 from 2026-09-03 and is up 18% in September on the Hormuz blockade. This is the obvious driver of the September drawdown and it is fully public: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/09/oil-prices-today-wti-brent-us-iran-hormuz-attacks.html. It points to a raw-material risk to the Q4 guide, but the price already carries it. The June-August dip against a minimum 10% April price increase could help the Q3 price/cost spread, but management said raw materials flow through with a lag and 'even more in the second half', so the sign for Q3 is ambiguous.

Pre-buy read-through from Avery Dennison: Q2 2026 had about half of its 8% organic growth from customer pre-buying, with an expected $0.25 Q3 headwind (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/avery-dennison-corporation-q2-2026-215106999.html). Henkel also said there would be 'no further significant forward buying' in H2. Dropped: it is a proxy, and FUL's own Q2 shows no pre-buy, with organic +2.6% on pricing +3.0% and volume slightly lower. Without a pre-buy there is no unwind. FUL also already guides a mid-single-digit H2 volume decline.

Peer adhesive prints after FUL last spoke: Arkema/Bostik Q2 had organic +3.8% with volumes +0.4% and a best-ever quarter (2026-07-30), and Henkel Adhesive Technologies raised its FY organic guide to 2-4% (Q2 +7.4%). Both are consistent with FUL's guide and give no stale-consensus signal. https://www.adhesivesmag.com/articles/102570-arkema-posts-strong-second-quarter-despite-middle-east-challenges

Kimberly-Clark at the Barclays conference (HHC customer read-through): discarded as misdated. The article's content references 'remainder of 2025' and the LA distribution centre fire, so it is the 2025 conference, and the URL carries no year.
No new FUL price increase announcement since the April 2026 minimum 10%. No WARN notices or plant closures found. No analyst estimate-revision data reachable (Benzinga and Alphastreet returned 403).
Activists (Ancora BAS bid rejected 2026-08-24, Engine Capital market-check letter 2026-08-14): public for a month, and no dated catalyst inside the window.
baseline_tension: Nothing I found contradicts the baseline. The name is already -13.7% over 20 days and -25.9% from its high, upside is paid (skew -5.73), and short interest is low, so the price already carries the oil re-spike and the AMS leverage worry, and I have no document-level fact that says the Q4 guide or the Q3 margin will differ from what that price implies.
